method: Read exact pinned release source archives identified in licenses/upstream/SOURCES.json.
Search every Rust, HTML, CSS, JS, TOML and YAML source file up to4MB for ArtCraft, getartcraft and docs/brand references; inspect runtime drawing and include-byte call sites.
Search all thirteen original WASM binaries for complete original docs/brand PNG/SVG bytes AND every SVG path-d geometry. The latter identifies DesignCraft's separately compiled path constant.
Parse WASM data segment boundaries for every detected graphic; distinguish separately licensed application icons using original per-asset license/attribution files.
Review official-suite runtime labels separately from copyright and source links. Localization table occurrences are not substituted for runtime occurrences.
limits: This is a bounded source/byte review of the pinned web releases, not a formal proof that arbitrary encoded or procedurally transformed artwork can never occur, nor a full dependency license audit.
